# definednet_endpoint_oidc_provider (Resource)

Manages an endpoint OIDC provider: the identity provider hosts on a network sign in with (endpoint SSO). An enabled provider needs a verified domain; reference `domain_id` from a `definednet_domain_verification` so the provider is created after verification.

The client secret is supplied either as `client_secret`, which is stored in state, or as `client_secret_wo` with `client_secret_wo_version`, which is never stored (Terraform 1.11 / OpenTofu 1.11 or newer). The API never returns the secret, so Terraform cannot detect a secret changed outside Terraform; every update re-sends the configured one.

The API runs OIDC discovery against `issuer_url` on every create and update, so any update, including a secret rotation, fails while the identity provider's discovery endpoint is unreachable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Preferred: the secret never enters plan or state (Terraform 1.11+ / OpenTofu 1.11+).
# Bump client_secret_wo_version whenever the secret is rotated.
resource "definednet_endpoint_oidc_provider" "okta" {
  name                     = "Okta"
  issuer_url               = "https://corp.okta.com"
  client_id                = var.okta_client_id
  client_secret_wo         = var.okta_client_secret
  client_secret_wo_version = 1

  network_id          = definednet_network.main.id
  role_id             = definednet_role.employee.id
  auth_validity_hours = 168

  # Reference the verification, not the domain, so the provider is created
  # only after the domain is verified.
  domain_id = definednet_domain_verification.corp.domain_id
  enabled   = true
}

# Alternative for older Terraform: the secret is stored (sensitive) in state.
resource "definednet_endpoint_oidc_provider" "google" {
  name          = "Google"
  issuer_url    = "https://accounts.google.com"
  client_id     = var.google_client_id
  client_secret = var.google_client_secret
  network_id    = definednet_network.main.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) OAuth client ID issued by the identity provider, 1-255 characters.
- `issuer_url` (String) OIDC issuer URL, e.g. `https://accounts.google.com`. Must be https.
- `name` (String) Provider name, 1-50 characters, unique within the organization.
- `network_id` (String) Network that hosts enrolling through this provider join.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `auth_validity_hours` (Number) How long a sign-in stays valid, 1 to 43800 hours. Omit for the API default.
- `auto_assign_cidrs` (Set of String) IPv4 prefix hosts enrolling through this provider draw addresses from: either empty or the network's own `ipv4_cidr`, which the API rejects any other prefix for. IPv6 is always assigned and is not listed here; the full stored list is the network's `cidrs`. Omit to accept the server's value (and the new network's default when `network_id` changes), set `[]` to assign IPv6 only. A certificate version 1 network always assigns IPv4, so the API rejects `[]` there and the provider rejects it at plan time; setting `[]` needs the `networks:read` scope, because the provider reads the network to check its certificate version.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth client secret, stored in state. Exactly one of `client_secret` and `client_secret_wo` must be set.
- `client_secret_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) OAuth client secret as a write-only argument: sent to the API but never stored in plan or state. Requires `client_secret_wo_version`; change the version to re-send a rotated secret.
- `client_secret_wo_version` (Number) Version counter for `client_secret_wo`. Terraform cannot see the write-only value, so increment this to trigger an update that re-sends it.
- `domain_id` (String) Verified domain users must belong to. Required when `enabled` is true; only one enabled provider may hold a domain.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether hosts may sign in through this provider. Requires `domain_id`, and the domain must be verified. Defaults to `false`.
- `role_id` (String) Role assigned to hosts enrolling through this provider.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Provider ID, e.g. `endpointoidc-X47KHSCOSQJP5IOKNNKRRGHVAI`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import definednet_endpoint_oidc_provider.okta endpointoidc-X47KHSCOSQJP5IOKNNKRRGHVAI
```
